From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Request: clear to open headcount and interview loop for Senior Inference Engineer

Team —

Quick summary: this is a backfill for the inference infra team (replacement for Raj, who transitioned to Research last month). I’m requesting permission to open the requisition and lock the interview loop so we can schedule first-rounds the week of Dec 6. Key points: 

- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (IC4) — hands-on with runtime, batching, kernel tuning.
- Justification: sustained capacity shortfall on production runtime; two 10% incidents in Q3 attributable to lack of senior ramp.
- Budget: attached spreadsheet shows approved headcount funds (req_budget_Q4.xlsx).
- Proposed interview loop: 45m system design (Marissa), 45m runtime deep-dive (Markus), 30m behavioral + comp fit (Laura).
- Proposed hiring band: $170k–$210k (total comp).

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v3.docx, req_budget_Q4.xlsx

Asks: 
1) Approval to open the req and assign a GH job id (greenhouse link below).
2) Confirmation of interviewers above and any conflicts for week of Dec 6.
3) If approved, I’ll ask Isabel (external recruiter) to send candidate availability; she has one strong referral (Michael Torres) who’s available early Dec.

Links: https://greenhouse.example.com/j/RI-1234 (placeholder)

If I don’t hear objections by EOD Thu (Nov 19), I’ll proceed to request posting and schedule the initial screen.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Inference & Serving
Redwood Inference

Olga — thanks for the write-up. I support opening the req; the scope and justification make sense. Two quick asks before you post:

If you can send a one-line confirmation on band, I’ll sign off and coordinate with HR to fast-track the posting.
